author: ImRaging
body:
ive been contemplating whether to make a goodbye post for a while because i never really felt that it was needed.

tbh many people, including myself thought this day wouldve come like 2 years ago so ty to the staff that allowed it to stay open so that we could finally win a god damned tourney.

i havent been properly active (as in playing on public a few times a week) for a long ass time and have come and gone for the tourneys.

I enjoyed being staff for the time that i was

im glad i made friends that are probably pedos and catfish (especially peachy)

please posts your screenies, clips or just written memories of the times that you had on here because no matter how buggy, laggy (block lag lul) or - simply put - shit this server was at many times, everyone has had good memories made on here, whether thats winning a tournament or fucking around in public with your friends

fuck you and thank you avicus,  for all the rage and all the happiness that you have caused every person to ever come onto this server.

thank you keenan for starting this and maintaining this till its very end.

thank you to all of the staff, current, demoted and retired for all the work you put into this server

thank you to all of my friends that ive made here, its truly been a wonderful ride and about as good as you can get for online fucking lego.

for the last time, bye avicus



Guess ALM really did steal christmas 


;)
